title: Erhu Night River (China Instrumental)
style: Chinese erhu pure instrumental guzheng pipa soft percussion 74bpm meditative traditional Chinese classical no vocals cinematic atmospheric watercolour textural pentatonic
lyrics:
[Instrumental — erhu, guzheng, pipa, soft percussion]

[Opening — erhu single line, river feel]

[Guzheng enters — harmonic texture]

[Full texture — erhu melody over guzheng]

[Pipa interlude — plucked accents]

[Return — erhu and guzheng together]

[Fade — erhu alone]
